title: Evidence record, Markdown frontmatter
description: Open format for a verification or validation record (D-007, D-026, SR-028). A manual record is a Markdown file with this frontmatter; the text below may describe the check. Automatic test results stay JUnit XML; the same fields are JUnit properties, see docs/adr/0012-evidence-records.md. The evidence itself stays where it is; `evidence` only points to it. Records written by ReqSeq (SR-030) and by anyone else count the same.

kind.description: Verification or validation (D-007). Validation counts only for the validation status (SR-030 AK3).

element.description: Verification: a requirement. Validation: a need or a requirement (D-012).

variant.description: Variant the record holds for. Absent: the core (D-026, SR-047 AK2), and also every variant the element applies in when the element's repository is marked `variant-independent` in the workspace file (SR-173). Verification only: a validation record with a variant is refused and counts for no status (D-007, SR-038 AK4).

item.description: The item under test: the concrete build or sample that was checked. Required for verification, optional for validation (D-007).

reason.description: The reason for an `inconclusive` validation, at least one character that is not white space; required with `inconclusive` and only there (SR-172 AK1). A reader warns about it on another result and reads the record without it (spec question #807).

evidence.description: Where the evidence is: relative path, file URL or any URI. ReqSeq does not open or manage it.

test-case.description: Optional test case name or ID (D-026, SR-033).

criteria.description: The acceptance criteria the record holds for, by number: the position in the property with the meaning `acceptance-criteria` of the element's `version`, counted from 1 (D-072, SR-028 AK4). Absent: every criterion. Verification only: a reader warns about it on a validation record, which counts per element (SR-030 AK3), and reads the record without it. A number that the named version does not have is a finding of `workspace check` (`evidence.unknown-criterion`, SR-028 AK5).
